title: Mark of a Killer
source_summary: Historical case reference | Wikipedia article extract: The Mark of a Killer (or simply Mark of a Killer) is an American true crime television series currently airing on the Oxygen Network.  The program examines the behaviors of serial killers. As of Season 3, the series is currently titled Mark of a Serial Killer.
